edge_explainer: Two independent findings kill the screen's framing. (1) The headline 8.6x trailing P/E is 57% fake: SEC XBRL shows Q1 FY26 net income of $1,016M against $228M of operating income, driven by ~$886M of equity-method income in that single quarter versus a ~$18M/quarter run-rate (FY25 full year: $72.2M). Clean trailing GAAP EPS is ~$2.61 -> ~19.7x, and forward is 16.7x. The screen ranked MKC on a number a non-cash JV remeasurement created. (2) MKC agreed on 2026-03-31 to combine with Unilever's Foods business in a ~$42.7-45bn transaction where Unilever shareholders reportedly take the majority stake - so every per-share input (cap, EV, forward EPS from 12-13 standalone-modelling analysts) is a pre-deal stub. Path is the only attribute favouring the name (+14.9% off a 79-day-old low, the least-bounced in the cohort) and it is not enough. Also a gate defect: GUIDE-DECEL fired on the FY27-vs-FY26 revenue step-down, which is just the acquisition anniversary rolling off (FY26 +15.4%, FY27 +3.6%, trailing 2.5%).
top_unverifiable: The exact identity of the ~$886M Q1 FY26 equity-method gain. XBRL confirms magnitude and non-recurrence; the 10-Q footnote naming the JV / step-acquisition was not read.
